title: Southern hairy-nosed wombat found to deliver key environmental benefits
title_zh: 南部毛鼻袋熊的生态价值
summary_zh: 长期被视为害兽的南部毛鼻袋熊，被证实能提供关键的环境生态价值，专家呼吁加强对其保护。
snippet: The southern hairy-nosed wombat, a species long persecuted by farmers in South Australia, has been found to deliver key environmental benefits, and researcher Dr. Ruth Norris believes it warrants urgent protection.

title: Local AI trained on gut microbe data could help African livestock withstand heat
title_zh: AI赋能牲畜耐热能力评估
summary_zh: 研究人员开发了一种基于肠道微生物数据的AI模型，旨在帮助非洲农业提升牲畜应对极端气候的能力。
snippet: In a study published in Agriculture, researchers from the University of Johannesburg (UJ) propose a policy roadmap for an AI-driven precision farming approach to further improve indigenous and other livestock breeds' abilities to withstand extreme conditions in farming operations of all sizes and types.

title: Tiny solar whirlpools may hold the secret to the sun's blistering corona
title_zh: 太阳表面的微型漩涡或解开日冕高温之谜
summary_zh: 最新研究认为，太阳表面数以百万计的微小漩涡可能是驱动太阳日冕层温度远高于表面的能量来源。
snippet: For the second time in a few weeks, we're writing about research into the temperature gap between the sun's surface and its corona. More and more data from various missions continue to feed this wave of discovery. A new paper by Katariina Nykyri of Embry-Riddle, recently published in The Astrophysical Journal Letters, adds to this growing body of work. She argues that millions of tiny whirlpools scattered across the sun's surface could be the energetic engine driving that temperature difference.

title: Simulated moon dust turned into LEGO-like blocks for settlements
title_zh: 利用月球尘埃打印建筑砖块
summary_zh: 阿肯色大学研究表明，月球表面的风化层物质可以进行3D打印，制作成类似乐高积木的构件，从而减少从地球运输建材的需求。
snippet: Permanent structures on the moon could start with something already there: lunar dust. New research from the University of Arkansas shows that pure regolith, the loose material that covers the moon, could be 3D-printed into LEGO-like bricks. Using it for construction could reduce what NASA needs to send from Earth as it works toward future lunar settlements.

title: What a 99-million-year-old feather is telling us about the evolution of flight
title_zh: 亿年琥珀羽毛揭秘恐龙飞行进化
summary_zh: 一颗在琥珀中保存了9900万年的恐龙羽毛化石，为研究鸟类飞行演化的关键结构提供了新的解剖线索。
snippet: Long before birds took to the skies, dinosaurs were already sporting feathers. But exactly how they evolved into the sophisticated structures that allow birds to fly remains something of a mystery. Now, the discovery of the longest feather ever found preserved in amber is providing some new clues.

title: Q&A: Exploring generative AI's impact on student thinking during programming and debugging
title_zh: 生成式AI对学生编程思维的影响研究
summary_zh: 一项博士论文研究探讨了生成式AI工具如何改变学生在编程调试过程中的高阶思维与认知表现。
snippet: The doctoral dissertation of Yazid Albadarin, MSc, entitled "Capturing the impact of generative AI on higher-order thinking, creativity, and cognitive dynamics during debugging" will be examined at the Faculty of Science, Forestry and Technology, Joensuu campus.

title: Cool adaptations: How fish survive in the Antarctic Ocean
title_zh: 南极深海鱼类的极寒生存机制
summary_zh: 研究人员分析了南极刺 plunderfish 的基因组，揭示了该物种通过特定的基因遗传机制适应极低水温的进化策略。
snippet: With water temperatures as low as -1.9°C (28.6°F), the Southern Ocean is a place of extreme living conditions. A new study led by Senckenberg researchers shows how fish have adapted to Antarctic temperatures. The researchers used the Antarctic spiny plunderfish (Harpagifer antarcticus) as a model organism and, for the first time, analyzed the maternal and paternal copies of its genome separately. This allowed them to uncover mechanisms that contribute to this group of fishes' adaptation to extre

title: Severe ocean risks threaten food prices, pensions and global economic resilience
title_zh: 海洋危机带来的全球经济风险
summary_zh: 最新行业报告警告称，海洋环境风险的加剧将对全球粮食价格、养老金体系及经济稳定性构成灾难性威胁。
snippet: Ocean risks are already severe and worsening, with the potential to become catastrophic without a change of course, according to a new report from the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA), the University of Exeter and The Ocean Race.

title: Laser-driven magnetic state defies equilibrium rules
title_zh: 激光激发下的新型量子磁态
summary_zh: 科学家利用激光和中子束在磁性材料中观察到了一种远离平衡态的持久量子态，这项发现有望推动未来量子存储与信息技术的发展。
snippet: Researchers at the Department of Energy's (DOE's) Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) and their collaborators used lasers and neutrons to observe a long-lived quantum state in a magnetic material, opening a new way to study materials systems driven far from their equilibrium. Manipulation of quantum magnets is important for advancing quantum information science and could reduce loss of transported information, improve memory devices and benefit other quantum technologies.

title: LHC collaboration presents first result in the hunt for 'quirks'
title_zh: 大型强子对撞机探索“夸克”类粒子未果
summary_zh: 基于LHC上FASER实验的三年数据，科学家未发现名为“夸克（quirks）”的假设粒子，该粒子曾被期望用于解释引力与其他基本作用力的巨大差异。
snippet: An international collaboration of physicists has presented its first results in its search for hypothetical particles that could help to explain the vast disparity between the strength of gravity and the three fundamental forces described by the Standard Model. Following three years of data collection at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC)'s FASER experiment, the FASER Collaboration found no evidence for these heavy, slow-moving "quirks."

title: High oil prices have led to a dip in global carbon emissions
title_zh: 油价上涨或带动碳排放减少
summary_zh: 近期数据指出，全球化石燃料的碳排放量出现了0.4%的逆势下滑，这可能与高油价抑制能源消费有关。
snippet: Bucking recent trends, fossil fuel emissions look to be down 0.4 percent.

title: NASA Scientists Show How Gravitational Waves Can Reveal New Worlds
title_zh: 引力波探测器有望发现系外行星
summary_zh: NASA科学家指出，正在研发的LISA引力波探测器不仅能观测时空波动，还有望协助人类识别银河系内独特的系外行星群体。
snippet: The LISA (Laser Interferometer Space Antenna) observatory, now in development, will detect gravitational waves, the tiny ripples in space-time caused by orbiting masses. Now two studies led by NASA astrophysicists show in new detail how LISA could reveal a new and unique population of exoplanets — worlds beyond our solar system — throughout our galaxy. […]

title: The Case for a Bubble at Life’s Start
title_zh: 生命起源的“泡沫”假说
summary_zh: 脂质（lipid）形成膜的理论认为，细胞膜的自我封闭特性为早期化学反应提供了聚集场所，是生命诞生的关键步骤。
snippet: Is self-enclosure life’s greatest trick? According to the lipid-first theory, a cell membrane enabled life by giving chemistry a place to gather. The post The Case for a Bubble at Life’s Start first appeared on Quanta Magazine

title: CHAPEA Crew Leaves a Mark
title_zh: CHAPEA任务圆满完成火星生存模拟
summary_zh: 四名志愿者在NASA约翰逊航天中心的封闭环境中生活了378天，成功模拟了火星任务期间的生存与科研状况。
snippet: The Crew Health and Performance Exploration Analog (CHAPEA) Mission 2 crew arranged photos around a boot print in the simulated Martian sand outside their habitat on Aug. 31, 2026. The crew recently exited their habitat on Saturday, Oct. 31, after 378 days of isolation in a facility at the agency’s Johnson Space Center in Houston. Health […]

title: Science to restore speech is moving fast. Here’s what’s next
title_zh: 脑机接口助力失语者发声
summary_zh: 神经科技正致力于恢复语言障碍者的自然发声能力，这项快速发展的技术有望改变患者的生活。
snippet: As neurotechnology aims to restore seamless speech to those who can no longer talk, what’s next for the science, and for the people it promises to help?

title: Making metal–organic frameworks easier to shape for electronic devices
title_zh: 改进金属有机框架材料的成型工艺
summary_zh: 金属有机框架（Metal–organic frameworks, MOFs）是一种由金属离子和有机分子构成的多孔材料，科研人员正在优化其结构设计，以便将其应用于电子设备中。
snippet: In 1974, the University of Melbourne's chemistry professor Richard Robson had the idea of replacing the wooden balls and metal rods used in structural models with molecules and chemical bonds. He began experimenting with copper ions linked by a four-armed organic molecule, creating a structure with a cavity. His work laid the foundation for metal–organic frameworks (MOFs), a class of porous materials formed by linking metal ions with organic molecules. Their pores can capture pollutants, support

title: Toxic secrets are hiding in Arctic ice
title_zh: 北极冰芯揭示了历史性工业污染的痕迹
summary_zh: 科学家通过分析北极冰芯，追踪到了源自蒙大拿州早期采矿和冶炼活动产生的砷、铅等重金属污染，这些污染物随大气环流沉降在极地。
snippet: Toxic metals can harm human health. Arctic ice cores trace arsenic, lead and other heavy metals to historic mining and smelting in Montana.

title: Ice core records uncover widespread air pollution from early 20th-century copper production
title_zh: 冰芯记录揭示20世纪早期的广泛空气污染
summary_zh: 冰芯研究显示，一个世纪前蒙大拿州铜矿的大规模开采产生了大量重金属颗粒，并通过大气传输污染了北极环境。
snippet: About a century ago, the Anaconda Copper Mine complex near Butte, Montana, was emitting vast amounts of air pollution into the atmosphere. As small particles of arsenic and other heavy metals were carried by winds over the Arctic, storms eventually helped pull them to the ground, where they joined layers of history embedded in the ice.

title: Digging up the past can change the ground beneath it
title_zh: 考古发掘对遗址环境的影响
summary_zh: 土耳其与美国科研人员利用计算机模型分析了考古发掘如何改变地貌，并提出预防发掘现场水土流失和侵蚀的规划策略。
snippet: Archaeological excavation uncovers the past but also changes the landscape that has preserved sites for centuries or millennia. These changes influence water flow, soil erosion and the stability of exposed remains. Researchers from Istanbul Technical University and the U.S. have shown how computer models can assist archaeologists in understanding and planning for these effects, especially regarding erosion risks. Using an Early Bronze Age settlement in Türkiye as a case study, they reconstructed

title: Heat-trapping carbon pollution drops, but scientists cite the Iran war rather than energy progress
title_zh: 碳排放下降的背后因素分析
summary_zh: 尽管今年全球碳排放量有所下降，科学家认为这主要是地缘政治冲击导致的经济反应，而非气候政策的显著成果。
snippet: Global carbon pollution dropped this year ever so slightly, but it's more because of oil shocks reverberating from the Iran war than anything the world has done to fight climate change, scientists said in a new study.

title: APOD: 2026 November 10 – Saturn Behind the Moon
title_zh: 天文美图：月掩土星
summary_zh: NASA每日天文图（APOD）展示了月球运行至土星前方的天文现象。
snippet: APOD Science APOD APOD: 2026 November 10 –… Today’s APOD Archive Submissions Index Search Calendar RSS Education About Discuss APOD Astronomy Picture of the Day Discover the cosmos! title: Autumn Mornings Bring Valley Fog
title_zh: 阿巴拉契亚山谷的晨间雾气
summary_zh: NASA卫星记录了阿巴拉契亚高原山谷中随地形分布的低空云雾现象。
snippet: Low clouds trace the branching valleys of the Appalachian Plateau and the Cumberland River, then burn off by afternoon.

title: Math anxiety may be stopping students from learning useful AI and data skills
title_zh: 数学焦虑可能阻碍学生掌握AI与数据技能
summary_zh: 研究指出，对数学的焦虑心理会影响学生学习人工智能及相关数据分析技能的积极性与能力，强调了批判性思维教育的重要性。
snippet: Artificial intelligence is increasingly becoming part of everyday life and work. AI can generate information, summarize evidence and perform calculations. However, it does not remove the need for critical thinking and conceptual understanding.

title: Light-pulse pairs reveal the femtosecond decay of an inner-shell hole in xenon atoms
title_zh: 观测到氙原子内层空穴的超快衰变
summary_zh: 科研人员利用同步辐射光源产生的超紫外脉冲，在时间维度上成功观测到了氙原子内层电子空穴（inner-shell hole）在飞秒（femtosecond）尺度内的衰变过程。
snippet: Researchers at the UVSOR Synchrotron Facility (Institute for Molecular Science, Japan) and partner institutions have observed the decay of a xenon 4d core hole, an inner-shell vacancy, directly in the time domain. They used pairs of phase-coherent extreme ultraviolet pulses from a synchrotron to make the photoelectron wave packets they released interfere. The contrast of the interference fringes decreased over a few femtoseconds as the delay between the pulses increased. A model using literature

title: AI-assisted atomic models reveal how protective shells regulate aluminum nanoparticle oxidation
title_zh: AI辅助模型揭示铝纳米颗粒的氧化机制
summary_zh: 研究人员开发了一种名为“MLP Copilot”的AI智能体，用于辅助构建原子交互模型，从而更清晰地理解纳米铝表面的保护层如何调节氧化过程。
snippet: Building an accurate model of how atoms interact is a complicated process. Researchers must choose new calculations, test successive models and track the mechanisms behind each interaction. But a newly developed AI agent called MLP Copilot has made this process much easier by bridging computational tools and scientific evidence with human supervision.

title: Alzheimer’s may have early warning signs outside the brain
title_zh: 阿尔茨海默病可能存在脑外预警信号
summary_zh: 一项基于人类细胞的实验室小型研究发现，与遗传性阿尔茨海默病相关的基因突变可能在脑部病变前，先破坏神经与肌肉的连接，这或许能解释部分患者早期平衡与步态协调出现的问题。
snippet: A surprising discovery suggests that some early signs of Alzheimer’s disease may begin outside the brain. Using miniature laboratory systems made from human cells, scientists found that genetic mutations associated with inherited Alzheimer’s can disrupt nerve-to-muscle connections without any involvement from the brain or spinal cord. This could help explain why some patients experience changes in balance, walking, and coordination long before memory problems develop.

title: Barium titanate's optical properties emerge more clearly after decades of widely varying measurements
title_zh: 确定钛酸钡的光学性质
summary_zh: 科研团队对钛酸钡（Barium titanate, BTO）的光传播与吸收特性进行了定性，这将为下一代光通信器件的设计提供重要参数基础。
snippet: A KAIST-led research team has characterized how light propagates through and is absorbed by barium titanate (BTO), a promising material for next-generation optical communication devices. By clarifying optical properties that had been difficult to determine because of the material's complex internal structure, the study provides a foundation for designing these devices.

title: Electrical technique concentrates milk without using heat, challenging traditional preservation methods
title_zh: 新型电学技术实现牛奶浓缩，无需加热
summary_zh: 这项新技术无需高温即可将牛奶浓缩，避免了传统热处理对乳清蛋白、酶和维生素等热敏感成分的破坏，同时降低了能耗。
snippet: Dehydrating milk to turn it into powder is, today, an energy-intensive process that subjects the product to high temperatures. Powdered milk is widely used by the food industry and allows the product to be stored and transported in a stable condition for long periods of time without the need for refrigeration. While industrial methods are effective, they have high energy costs and can alter heat-sensitive components, such as whey proteins, enzymes or vitamins.

title_zh: 好奇号火星车进入蓄电与维护阶段
summary_zh: NASA的好奇号火星车（Curiosity）在执行完近期钻探任务后，安排了数个火星日（sol）进行系统充电与状态维护。

summary_zh: 火星车在“Nazca”地点完成了第49次钻探，科研团队正在分析岩石中发现的盘状内含物是否为矿物晶体。

title: Fossil fuel emissions are down in 2026. Green energy isn’t the reason
title_zh: 2026年全球化石燃料排放量下降并非全因绿色能源
summary_zh: 尽管全球碳排放量小幅下降，但分析指出这更多是受伊朗战争引发的气体价格波动影响，而非能源转型的直接结果。
snippet: It's not quite a victory for humanity's transition to renewables. The dip is probably driven by high gas prices from the Iran war.

title: Fossil CO₂ emissions projected to decrease in 2026 amid clean energy growth and Iran conflict
title_zh: 2026年全球化石碳排放预计减少
summary_zh: 全球碳计划（Global Carbon Project）报告显示，受风能与太阳能增长及地缘冲突的影响，2026年化石燃料产生的碳排放量预计将下降0.4%。
snippet: Global carbon emissions from fossil fuels are projected to decrease by 0.4% in 2026—driven by expansion of solar and wind power and the Iran conflict—according to new research by the Global Carbon Project. The 2026 edition (the 21st annual report) is published in the journal Earth System Science Data.

title: After 40 years, CERN finds evidence of a one-in-10-billion particle decay
title_zh: CERN观测到百亿分之一概率的粒子衰变
summary_zh: 欧洲核子研究中心（CERN）经过40年研究，终于证实了一种极罕见的粒子衰变现象，这对探索超越现有物理标准模型的新粒子与新作用力具有重要意义。
snippet: CERN scientists have finally found evidence of a particle decay so rare that it happens only once in roughly 10 billion decays, ending a search spanning more than 40 years. The breakthrough could help physicists uncover hidden particles and forces that lie beyond the reach of today's most powerful accelerators.

title: Scientists finally discover why we learn to love bitter coffee
title_zh: 科学家揭示为何我们会爱上苦咖啡
summary_zh: 科学家发现了一条从肠道到大脑的多巴胺（dopamine，一种与奖赏和愉悦感相关的神经递质）通路，解释了人类为何能在多次尝试后从厌恶苦味转变为喜爱咖啡等食物。这项研究揭示了大脑建立饮食偏好的机制，未来可能有助于通过干预该通路来改善饮食习惯。
snippet: Scientists have uncovered a hidden gut-to-brain dopamine pathway that helps explain why bitter coffee and other initially unpleasant flavors can become favorites over time. The discovery reveals how the brain learns to crave certain foods and could eventually lead to new ways of reshaping eating habits and food preferences.

title: Rubies on Mars?
title_zh: 火星上有红宝石吗？
summary_zh: 毅力号火星车（Perseverance）利用其精密仪器对火星岩石样本进行探测，旨在揭示这颗古老星球的矿物组成与地质历史。
snippet: Written by Roger C. Wiens, SuperCam Principal Investigator for NASA’s Perseverance rover at Purdue University Nov. 4, 2026 Exploration on Mars turns up the unexpected. Perseverance is equipped with a fantastic set of instruments for studying the rock record of this ancient planet. Both PIXL and SuperCam have great capabilities for detecting all kinds of […]

title: Newest Sample, Oldest Rock?
title_zh: 毅力号获取新的火星岩石样本
summary_zh: 毅力号火星车对名为“Pumbe”的岩石进行了磨削分析，该岩石质地极硬，与之前难以钻探的样本具有相似特征。
snippet: Written by Tasha Coelho, Mastcam-Z Student Collaborator at Arizona State University Nov. 1, 2026 Perseverance’s most recent abrasion “Pumbe” bears a striking resemblance to an earlier abrasion, “Badger Peak.” That’s no coincidence. As previously reported, that rock had a hardness too high to core. However, the team felt strongly that it was worth the effort […]

title: CheMeleon model adapts to predict molecular properties from scant data
title_zh: CheMeleon模型可利用少量数据预测分子属性
summary_zh: 新型AI模型CheMeleon能通过有限数据预测化学化合物的特性，有望加速新药及新材料的研发效率。
explain_zh: MIT开发了一种名为CheMeleon的AI基础模型，能够利用少量实验数据预测分子的多种理化性质，如药效（potency）和毒性（toxicity）。该模型通过预先学习约一百万个分子的描述符来“理解”化学规律，随后针对具体任务进行微调，显著减少了新药研发过程中所需的实验筛选次数。这种方法在处理数据匮乏的化合物开发任务中表现优异，已在制药行业得到初步应用。
snippet: Discovering new molecules for specific uses is a major driver of progress in a wide variety of industries, whether it's pharmaceutical companies looking for new drugs or electronics or energy companies seeking new materials with particular properties. But it's also largely a trial-and-error process, because there is not yet any way to perfectly predict how a given chemical compound will behave in terms of the myriad different properties and responses materials can exhibit.

title: New review maps a 'structure-to-physiology' roadmap for functional fruit packaging
title_zh: 功能性果蔬包装的结构与生理研究综述
summary_zh: 研究总结了包装结构如何通过控制果蔬呼吸与乙烯敏感度，减少采后损耗，提升保存质量。
snippet: Freshly harvested fruit remains metabolically active, respires vigorously and is highly sensitive to ethylene. It is therefore highly susceptible to softening, browning, water loss and decay. Currently, about 25% of fruit is lost in the postharvest supply chain because of inadequate preservation, transport or storage.

title: 3-million-year-old Taung Child once again shakes up our human family tree
title_zh: 300万年前的汤恩幼儿化石测定新结果
summary_zh: 研究将著名的“汤恩幼儿”（Taung Child）化石年代定为距今约300万年前，显示南部非洲早期人类演化过程比预想更为复杂。
snippet: A century after the Taung Child permanently altered our view of human origins, a new study published in npj Palaeoecosystems dates the famous fossil to between 2.96 and 3.03 million years old. Led by professor Gabriele Macho of the Archaeology, Environmental Changes and Geo-Chemistry (AMGC) research group at Vrije Universiteit Brussel (VUB), the international research highlights that the human family tree in southern Africa was far more complex than previously assumed.

title: Not a 'night owl' yet: Extraordinary bird fossil from Messel Pit suggests species still hunted by day
title_zh: 4700万年前化石表明早期猫头鹰或是昼行性
summary_zh: 通过分析一只猫头鹰化石腹中的蟑螂及骨骼结构，科学家发现该物种在古代可能主要在白天捕食。
snippet: An exceptionally well-preserved, approximately 47-million-year-old owl fossil from the UNESCO World Heritage Site Messel provides new clues as to when owls became nocturnal. The newly described species Masillastrix blattophaga was likely still diurnal—as indicated by an iridescent cockroach in its stomach, as well as the structure of its feathers and wing bones. In their new study, published in the journal Current Biology, the Senckenberg researchers speculate that nocturnal behavior in owls onl

title: Canines could help anthropological studies, answering questions about human evolution
title_zh: 狗或可作为人类演化研究的辅助对象
summary_zh: 人类学家提出，家犬在理解人类演化历程中可能与类人猿一样具备重要研究价值。
snippet: Anthropologists seeking to understand human evolution often include primates such as chimps or apes in their studies. But a new review paper by Kyle Smith, a postdoctoral research scholar in NC State's College of Veterinary Medicine, argues that an equally informative animal is often right under our noses—the domestic (or family) dog.

title: Extended mathematical language captures symmetry in layered materials
title_zh: 层状材料对称性分析的新数学框架
summary_zh: 科学家开发了一种数学模型来描述复杂层状材料的对称性，有助于优化材料在导热、导电及光学方面的应用。
snippet: Symmetry is all around us, from the repeating patterns of crystals to the stitches in a knitted sweater. In materials science, these patterns are more than just visually appealing: They can influence how a material conducts heat, transports electricity and interacts with light. Now, an international research team led by Tohoku University's Advanced Institute for Materials Research (WPI-AIMR) has developed a mathematical framework for describing symmetry in complex, layered structures, opening ne

title: Our sun's undiscovered stellar nemesis is still out there, says physicist
title_zh: 物理学家提出太阳可能存在未发现的伴星
summary_zh: 理论物理学家探讨了奥尔特云（Oort cloud）中彗星的起源，并重申存在未知恒星干扰的假说。
snippet: Long-period, high-inclination comets of the sort that can cause extinction-level impacts here on Earth have long been thought to originate from a theoretical Oort cloud. That is, a roughly spherical cloud of icy cometary objects that number in the trillions at distances that extend up to 1.6 light-years away.

title: Tiny beetle trapped in 53-million-year-old amber is named after Twenty One Pilots
title_zh: 5300万年前的琥珀甲虫被命名为“Twenty One Pilots”
summary_zh: 研究人员在法国发现了一种保存在琥珀（amber）中的新种甲虫化石。这是在该地区发现的首个正式描述的蚁形甲虫（puppet beetle），并以乐队名命名以示纪念。
snippet: Preserved in amber for about 53 million years, a beetle has been described as a new species by researchers in Spain and France. Named Cnopus twentyonepilotorum, it is the first puppet beetle (family Aderidae) to be formally described from the Oise amber of northern France. The findings are published in the journal ZooKeys.

title: Don't study alone: New research shows how loneliness impacts student health—and how universities can help
title_zh: 孤独感如何影响大学生的身心健康与学业
summary_zh: 一项针对大学生的研究分析了孤独感对健康及学业表现的负面影响，并建议高校采取具体干预措施，以改善学生的社交环境。
snippet: The negative impact of loneliness on health and well-being is well known, but for university students, social interaction can also be key to academic success. A new study by Constructor University professor Dr. Sonia Lippke and colleagues, published in the journal Frontiers in Psychology, analyzes the effects of student loneliness on health and academics and lays out concrete steps that universities can take to mitigate them.

title: Chimpanzees blowing raspberries offer first evidence of learned vocal conventions in great ape communication
title_zh: 黑猩猩通过社交学习发声，展现类人猿沟通中的文化迹象
summary_zh: 研究发现黑猩猩会模仿成年同伴发出特定的声音，类似于人类儿童学习词汇的过程，这为灵长类动物学习型交流提供了初步证据。
snippet: Chimpanzees may learn how to use some of their calls from the adults around them, in a surprising parallel with how human children learn words, finds a study from the CNRS Institute of Cognitive Sciences, University of Warwick and Taï Chimpanzee Project.

title: La NASA busca a la próxima generación de astronautas
title_zh: NASA开启新一代宇航员招募
summary_zh: NASA正式启动新一轮宇航员选拔，以支持未来载人航天任务及太空探索事业。
explain_zh: NASA已开启新一届宇航员选拔工作，旨在招募能参与重返月球、建设月球基地及未来火星任务的探索者。申请者需具备STEM领域硕士学位或相关职业经验，并需通过严格的体格检查及团队协作能力评估。此次招募是NASA Artemis计划的一部分，旨在确保人类在月球建立长期驻留点，并为未来的载人火星任务储备人才。
snippet: Read this release in English here.La NASA busca a los exploradores que ayudarán a escribir el próximo capítulo de los vuelos espaciales tripulados. Ya está abierto el plazo de inscripción para la próxima promoción de astronautas de la agencia, que se incorporarán a la NASA en un momento en el que Estados Unidos regresa a […]

title: Pentagon mulls placing fleet of military satellites around the Moon
title_zh: 五角大楼考虑在月球轨道部署卫星群
summary_zh: 美国国防部正在评估在环月空间部署军事卫星网络的计划，以加强地月空间能力。
explain_zh: 美国军方正在考虑在月球轨道部署名为“地月空间系统”（Cislunar Space System）的卫星星座，以支持军事任务需求。五角大楼已发布信息征询书（RFI），寻求在2029年左右实现多卫星在轨运行，任务重点在于对地月空间内物体的监视、导航与通信保障。此举反映了美军将地月区域视为“作战领域”，旨在预防该区域的资源竞争与潜在安全威胁。
snippet: "Please jump on my cislunar bandwagon because I need some more friends here."

title: NASA’s Chandra Finds Source of Star’s Mysterious Outbursts
title_zh: 钱德拉X射线望远镜发现恒星爆发源头
summary_zh: 天文学家通过Chandra X-ray Observatory发现，一颗巨大不稳定恒星每113天爆发一次是因为存在一颗隐蔽的伴星在夺取其物质。
snippet: Using NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory, astronomers have discovered what is triggering repeated outbursts from a giant, unstable star. A new study, published Monday in the latest issue of The Astrophysical Journal, details the discovery of a previously hidden companion object that keeps pulling material away from the massive star every 113 days as they orbit […]

title: NASA Advanced Mid-Power Electric Rocket Challenge
title_zh: NASA发布先进中功率电火箭挑战赛
summary_zh: NASA邀请商业公司开发3-7千瓦的霍尔效应推进器（Hall effect thruster），旨在提升未来卫星及深空探索的动力能力。
snippet: Mid-power (3-7 kW) Hall effect thruster systems have been identified by government and industry stakeholders as critical capabilities for satellite, defense, and exploration missions. Given the need for this capability, NASA is launching the Advanced Mid-Power Electric Rocket (AMPERE) Challenge. The NASA AMPERE Challenge invites U.S. commercial companies to develop and demonstrate mid-power Hall effect […]

title: La NASA destina un millón de dólares al reto estudiantil Base Lunar
title_zh: NASA设立百万美元月球基地学生挑战赛
summary_zh: NASA为“月球基地”学生设计挑战赛提供100万美元奖金，以激励航天领域的人才培养。
snippet: Read this release in English here.El domingo 8 de noviembre de 2026, la NASA anunció la convocatoria del reto estudiantil Base Lunar, dotado con un millón de dólares, durante un acto de MAX POWER celebrado en el Complejo de Visitantes del Centro Espacial Kennedy, en Florida. En el marco de una edad de oro de […]

title: Astronauts Across Generations Share the Stage
title_zh: 多代宇航员齐聚阿耳忒弥斯庆祝晚宴
summary_zh: 来自不同时代的宇航员聚集在肯尼迪航天中心，共同庆祝载人航天事业的进步。
snippet: On Nov. 6, 2026, Purpose Entertainment hosted the Artemis Celebration Gala at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex in Merritt Island, Florida. Held on the eve of NASA’s MAX POWER event, the gala celebrated the explorers, innovators, and visionaries advancing the next era of human spaceflight. The event honored the successful completion of the agency’s […]

title: MAX POWER: NASA’s Inaugural Aerospace Expo Ignites America’s Future
title_zh: NASA举办首届MAX POWER航空航天博览会
summary_zh: NASA在肯尼迪航天中心举办大型博览会，展示美国在空间技术与航空领域的领先实力。
snippet: Thousands gathered over several days in early November to experience MAX POWER – NASA’s first exhibition of America’s superiority in space, aeronautics, and technology on and around the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The multi-day, family-friendly event honored the nation’s 250th anniversary and served as a culmination of the agency’s Inspiration Tour. Among the […]

title: NASA’s ESCAPADE Completes Powered Earth Flybys, Now En Route to Mars
title_zh: ESCAPADE双探测器完成地球飞掠，启程前往火星
summary_zh: NASA的ESCAPADE火星探测任务已成功完成地球引力助推，预计将于2027年9月抵达火星。
explain_zh: NASA的ESCAPADE双探测器成功完成了两次动力地球引力助推，目前已正式开启前往火星的巡航阶段。研究团队采用了一种创新策略，先在围绕地球-太阳拉格朗日点2（L2）的轨道上驻留，随后利用地球引力与发动机点火的组合进行“动力引力助推”，不仅节省了燃料，还打破了每两年一次的发射窗口限制。这一技术演示若成功，将为未来更灵活的深空探测任务提供新的路径参考。
snippet: NASA’s two ESCAPADE (Escape and Plasma Acceleration and Dynamics Explorers) spacecraft have each successfully completed a powered Earth flyby, using Earth’s gravity in combination with a sustained engine burn to slingshot themselves toward Mars. With these successful maneuvers complete, the twin spacecraft are on target to reach the Red Planet in September 2027. “This is […]

title: Drugs like Ozempic may help reverse chronic kidney disease
title_zh: 司美格鲁肽或可逆转慢性肾病
summary_zh: 研究显示，司美格鲁肽（Semaglutide）可通过修复血管、抑制炎症及改善肾功能，为慢性肾病治疗提供新可能。
explain_zh: 研究发现，用于减重的药物司美格鲁肽（semaglutide）能修复慢性肾脏病患者受损的肾脏微血管，从而改善肾功能。研究者通过对比106名患者用药前后的肾组织样本及基因表达，发现该药物能增强肾血流量并减轻炎症。该发现不仅解释了该药预防肾衰竭的机制，也为慢性肾脏病的治疗提供了潜在的新药物靶点。
snippet: Scientists found that semaglutide, Ozempic’s key ingredient, repaired blood vessels, dampened inflammation and improved kidney function in patients.

title: Did Life Begin in an RNA World?
title_zh: 生命起源于“RNA世界”吗？
summary_zh: 科学界探讨生命最初是否源自能自我复制的RNA分子，研究指出仅靠自我复制可能不足以产生演化。该领域对理解生命起源至关重要。
snippet: Some believe the earliest life emerged from self-copying molecules that could mutate and even evolve. But that may not have been enough. The post Did Life Begin in an RNA World? first appeared on Quanta Magazine

title: A high-fiber diet may clear away plastic in the gut
title_zh: 高纤维饮食或有助于清除肠道微塑料
summary_zh: 这项在小鼠实验中的发现表明，膳食纤维可能包裹肠道内的微塑料颗粒并促进其排出。仍需进一步人类研究验证。
snippet: Research in mice shows that fiber may literally wrap around plastic particles to remove them from the gut.

title: New Democratic Congress will likely strip the gilding from Trump's Golden Dome
title_zh: 新一届国会或将重命名“金顶”项目
summary_zh: 美国国会政治变动可能导致特朗普时期命名的“金顶”（Golden Dome）计划面临更名风险。
snippet: "There’s no doubt that whatever it’s going to be called, it won’t be called Golden Dome."

title: A quantum breakthrough makes light behave like both a solid and a liquid
title_zh: 室温下的量子突破：光同时呈现固体与液体的特性
summary_zh: 科学家观测到一种罕见的量子态（quantum state），使光在室温下既具备晶体结构，又能实现无摩擦流动。这一发现有望推动光子计算和传感技术的革新。
explain_zh: 科学家首次在室温下观测到“超固体”（supersolid）这种奇特的量子物态，它同时具备晶体的周期性结构和超流体（superfluid）的零摩擦流动特性。研究团队利用光与物质强耦合产生的准粒子——激子极化激元（exciton polaritons），在微腔结构中实现了这一状态，克服了此前必须在接近绝对零度下才能观测的严苛限制。这一突破可能推动光计算及高灵敏度传感技术的快速发展。
snippet: Scientists have observed a bizarre quantum state of matter that combines the structure of a crystal with the frictionless flow of a liquid, all at room temperature. The breakthrough overturns a major practical limitation of exotic quantum experiments and could help bring powerful new light-based computing and sensing technologies closer to reality.

title: CHAPEA Mission 2 Crew Reflects After 378 Days on Simulated Mars
title_zh: CHAPEA任务第二期模拟火星生活结束
summary_zh: 四名志愿者在模拟火星栖息地生活378天后出舱，该实验旨在评估长期封闭环境下的生理心理影响。
snippet: After 378 days without windows, the sounds of the outside world, or real-time calls with family and friends, four research volunteers stepped out of NASA’s Mars Dune Alpha habitat on Oct. 31, completing the agency’s second yearlong Mars surface simulation. Ross Elder, Ellen Ellis, James Spicer, and Matthew Montgomery entered the roughly 1,700-square-foot, 3D-printed habitat at […]

title: Scientists discover a surprising link between acorns and lyme disease
title_zh: 橡子产量可预警莱姆病风险
summary_zh: 研究发现橡子（acorn）产量与两年后的蜱虫数量激增密切相关，且小鼠在传播莱姆病（Lyme disease）中的作用远比鹿群更为关键。
explain_zh: 一项长达35年的生态学研究揭示了莱姆病（Lyme disease）传播风险的驱动因素，发现橡树的结实量（acorn masting）能提前两年预测蜱虫数量的激增。研究通过长期监测森林生态系统发现，白足鼠是传播莱姆病病原体的重要媒介，而相比之下，鹿群对蜱虫数量的影响不如预期显著。这项研究强调了通过预测生态链条来预警传染病风险的价值，同时也指出极端天气下蜱虫的生存能力比预想更强。
snippet: After more than 35 years of research, scientists have uncovered surprising clues about what really drives Lyme disease risk. Contrary to longstanding assumptions, deer populations appear less important than mice, which can fuel a 40% increase in tick numbers the following year. Even acorn production can predict tick population surges two years in advance, while extreme temperatures may be far less deadly to ticks than scientists once believed.

title: A simple supplement may help clear brain fog after cancer
title_zh: 膳食补充剂或有助于缓解癌症后的“脑雾”
summary_zh: 一项针对乳腺癌幸存者的小规模人体研究发现，补充草酰乙酸（oxaloacetate）可能改善术后的记忆力衰退、注意力不集中及疲劳感。
snippet: A surprising new study from UCLA suggests that a naturally occurring molecule could help breast cancer survivors overcome the frustrating brain fog and exhaustion that can linger long after treatment ends. Researchers found that women taking an oxaloacetate supplement for eight weeks experienced substantial improvements in memory, concentration, mental clarity, and fatigue.

title: NASA reveals bold new plan to return astronauts to the Moon in 2028
title_zh: NASA计划于2028年重返月球
summary_zh: NASA公布了加速登月计划，通过与SpaceX和Blue Origin等商业航天公司合作，利用新型宇航服和更高效的火箭技术，目标是实现月球永久驻留及火星探索。
snippet: NASA has revealed an accelerated plan to land astronauts on the Moon in 2028, with SpaceX and Blue Origin developing competing lunar landers and a crucial orbital test scheduled for 2027. Faster rocket preparations, new lightweight spacesuits, and redesigned missions could help pave the way for a permanent lunar presence and future human exploration of Mars.

title: DNA on the Shroud of Turin reveals centuries of hidden secrets
title_zh: DNA分析揭示都灵裹尸布的隐藏秘密
summary_zh: 科学家通过对都灵裹尸布（Shroud of Turin）上残留的生物痕迹进行DNA分析，发现了复杂的成分混合，为研究该文物的历史与环境背景提供了新的科学视角。
snippet: The Shroud of Turin, one of history's most mysterious religious artifacts, is yielding surprising new clues through DNA analysis. Scientists have uncovered a complex mixture of biological traces that may reveal more about the cloth's past and the environments it encountered. The findings offer a fresh scientific perspective on a centuries-old mystery that continues to spark fascination and debate.

title: Crystals hint at a volcano's ability to erupt
title_zh: 微小晶体揭示火山喷发前兆
summary_zh: 澳大利亚昆士兰大学的研究人员发现，火山岩中的微小晶体能记录火山内部的活动轨迹，有望成为预测未来喷发时间的有力工具。
snippet: University of Queensland researchers have shown tiny crystals are a window to activity inside volcanoes and could provide clues to when they might erupt.

title: 'Burning': Life under the world's dirtiest skies
title_zh: 空气污染对生活环境的影响
summary_zh: 报道展现了印度首都周边地区极端空气污染现状，反映了全球部分地区在恶劣环境质量下人类生存面临的巨大健康挑战。
snippet: On the outskirts of India's capital, a short motorbike ride through the urban area with the world's worst air pollution leaves salesman Kanwar Singh coated in toxic dust.

title: APOD: 2026 November 9 – Rigel and the Witch Head Nebula
title_zh: 参宿七与女巫头星云
summary_zh: NASA发布了一张壮观的太空摄影图，展示了猎户座的明亮恒星参宿七（Rigel）与反射星云——女巫头星云（Witch Head Nebula）交相辉映的景象。

Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. Rigel and the […]

title: Ozone Hole Reaches Its 2026 Maximum
title_zh: 2026年臭氧层空洞监测情况
summary_zh: 监测数据显示，2026年的臭氧层空洞面积位列48年观测史中的第七大，但其深度相对以往的严重程度有所减弱。
snippet: The ozone hole ranked seventh largest by area in 48 years of monitoring, but it was not as deep as other large holes on record.

title: Despite sacrificing people after catastrophic El Niño flooding, ancient societies were generally peaceful
title_zh: 古文明在气候灾难下的社会反应
summary_zh: 考古研究发现，秘鲁北海岸的古代社会虽曾在厄尔尼诺现象引发的洪灾后采取过人祭行为，但整体社会结构在历史上依然保持了高度的和平性。
snippet: To understand how societies might react to climate change, archaeologists look at social responses to extreme climate events in the past—and in some places, that included measures as drastic as human sacrifice. Mass ritual sacrifices along the desert coast of northern Peru have been linked to catastrophic flooding caused by El Niño, which made researchers wonder if such sacrifices were part of a rise in violence driven by resource scarcity. But a new survey of the Lambayeque Valley suggests that

title: A new clinical simulation model strengthens the empowerment and autonomy of nursing staff
title_zh: 新型护理临床模拟模型
summary_zh: 一项新型临床模拟模型不再局限于单纯的技术评估，开始纳入护理伦理、医患互动及情绪管理，旨在提升护理人员的自主权与职业赋权。
snippet: To date, many of the methods used in clinical simulation have focused primarily on assessing technical skills and compliance with medical standards, often from a generic, interprofessional perspective. Although technical skills are essential, this approach overlooked key aspects of nursing practice, such as care ethics, relational presence with patients and emotional management among nurses.

title: Hidden climate superpower: Why some ocean “snow” carries six times more carbon
title_zh: 海洋“雪”的固碳作用
summary_zh: 研究发现海洋中“海洋雪”（marine snow，指海洋中不断沉降的有机碎屑）的粘性会影响其抵抗细菌分解的能力，高粘性颗粒能输送多出六倍的碳进入深海，这对调节地球气候意义重大。
snippet: Scientists have discovered that the stickiness of underwater “marine snow” plays a surprisingly important role in how much carbon reaches the deep ocean. Gooier particles resist bacterial breakdown and can transport more than six times as much carbon to the depths, revealing an unexpected connection between ocean slime and Earth's climate.

title: Radiocarbon analysis uncovers possible traces of hidden earthquakes off Japan's coast
title_zh: 日本沿海发现史前地震遗迹
summary_zh: 东京大学利用放射性碳定年法（radiocarbon analysis）分析日本熊野海沉积物，发现了南海海槽历史上未被记录的“隐形”大地震证据，有助于提升防灾预警能力。
explain_zh: 东京大学的研究团队在日本熊野海（Kumano Sea）的沉积物岩芯中，发现了多处此前通过肉眼及CT成像无法观测到的“隐藏”地震记录。研究者采用了超高分辨率的放射性碳测年法（radiocarbon dating），通过分析沉积物中总有机碳的碳-14含量，识别出因海底滑坡重新沉积的物质，并将其与历史地震记录进行对比。这项研究不仅揭示了南海海槽（Nankai Trough）更复杂的地震历史，其高灵敏度检测技术也为全球预测未来地质灾害提供了重要参考。
snippet: Researchers at the University of Tokyo have used a new type of radiocarbon analysis to study a sediment core taken from the Kumano Sea off the coast of Japan. This has revealed multiple "hidden" traces of previously unknown earthquakes in the Nankai Trough, where the country's next megaquake is expected to occur. Reconstructing a more accurate picture of the past will help predict future geophysical events and prepare for potential disasters. The work is published in Radiocarbon.

title: Small histone differences help shape gene regulation during sperm development
title_zh: 组蛋白微小差异对精子发育的影响
summary_zh: 九州大学研究显示，小鼠组蛋白变体H3mm15对于精子正常发育至关重要，哪怕仅有三个氨基酸的差异也会显著改变其在染色质（chromatin）中的调控功能。
snippet: Researchers from Kyushu University have found that H3mm15, a histone H3.3 subvariant, contributes to normal sperm development in mice by helping regulate gene expression during spermatogenesis. The findings show that H3mm15 cannot be interchanged with conventional H3.3; although the proteins differ at only three amino acids, they behave differently in chromatin, the DNA-protein structure that packages genetic material.

title: Scientists discover stunning new Amazon fish that may already be endangered
title_zh: 亚马逊新发现濒危鱼类
summary_zh: 科学家在巴西亚马逊地区发现了一种仅存于三处森林水池中的微型鱼类Laimosemion laranja，由于栖息地严重缩减，该物种正面临极高的灭绝风险。
snippet: Researchers have discovered a stunning new species of tiny orange-patterned fish in the Brazilian Amazon, but its survival may already be at risk. Named Laimosemion laranja, the brilliantly colored killifish measures less than three centimeters long and was found in just three small forest pools. Its extremely limited habitat is threatened by mining, deforestation, pollution, and expanding development.

title: Scientists wipe out deadly brain tumors in every mouse tested with new cancer therapy
title_zh: 新型CAR-T细胞疗法根除小鼠脑肿瘤
summary_zh: 加州大学旧金山分校开发了一种仅在脑部环境激活的B-SYNC CAR-T细胞疗法，在小鼠实验中成功清除了致死性的儿童弥漫性中线胶质瘤（DMG）。
snippet: Scientists at UC San Francisco have developed a powerful new cancer therapy that remains inactive until it reaches the brain, where it switches on to attack deadly tumors. The engineered immune cells, called B-SYNC CAR-T cells, completely eliminated diffuse midline glioma (DMG), an aggressive childhood brain cancer that is almost always fatal within a year, in two mouse models.

title: An ancient ocean full of giant predators reveals a surprising twist in evolution
title_zh: 远古海洋生态演化的新发现
summary_zh: 哥伦比亚的化石研究挑战了传统演化观点，提出生命演化中存在一种“生物转折点”（Biotic Inflection），即生态系统在没有发生大规模灭绝的情况下，也能经历剧烈的物种更新。
snippet: A remarkable fossil discovery in Colombia is challenging how scientists understand major evolutionary changes in Earth's history. Researchers uncovered an incredibly diverse ancient marine ecosystem where giant reptiles, sharks, and other creatures thrived as older evolutionary groups approached extinction and newer ones emerged. They call this previously unrecognized pattern a "Biotic Inflection," suggesting that major transformations in life can occur without mass extinctions.

title: Einstein's equations reveal how gravity could break, reconnect, and release energy
title_zh: 爱因斯坦方程中隐藏的引力重连
summary_zh: 科学家在爱因斯坦引力场方程中发现了一种新现象——“引力重连”（gravitational reconnection），理论上引力场结构能断裂并重连，从而向物质传递能量。
snippet: More than a century after Einstein revolutionized our understanding of gravity, scientists have uncovered a surprising new phenomenon hidden within his equations. Researchers at Columbia University and Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez have identified a theoretical process called "gravitational reconnection," in which structures within gravitational fields can break apart and reconnect, transferring energy into matter.

title: Liquid-assisted crystal growth cuts perovskite defects for efficient solar cells and LEDs
title_zh: 液体辅助晶体生长技术助力钙钛矿光电器件性能提升
summary_zh: 研究团队开发了一种通过液体辅助生长的钙钛矿（perovskite）半导体薄膜工艺，大幅减少了材料内部的缺陷，显著提升了太阳能电池和发光二极管（LED）的能量转换效率。
explain_zh: 研究团队开发了一种基于共晶混合物（eutectic mixture）的液体辅助生长方法，通过在较低温度下形成液态层，显著减少了钙钛矿（perovskite）薄膜中晶体晶界的缺陷。这种方法利用了混合物熔点降低的特性，促进了原子扩散与大晶粒生长，使薄膜表面复合速度达到创纪录的低值。由此制备的钙钛矿器件展现了高效的太阳能电池与LED性能，且无需昂贵的专业设备，为该材料的商业化应用铺平了道路。
snippet: A research team led by professor Seong Sik Shin of the SKKU Advanced Institute of Nanotechnology (SAINT) at Sungkyunkwan University (SKKU), in international collaboration with the Korea Research Institute of Chemical Technology (KRICT), the University of California, San Diego, and Princeton University, has developed a next-generation perovskite semiconductor thin film with dramatically reduced defects. Using the same material platform, the researchers demonstrated both high-performance solar cel

title: JWST tracks more than 100 magnified stellar events in the Dragon galaxy
title_zh: JWST在“龙”星系观测到百余起恒星增亮事件
summary_zh: 借助詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜（JWST），天文学家在65亿光年外的“龙”星系中发现了104起恒星增亮事件。这些事件揭示了遥远星系的恒星组成，并为研究暗物质（dark matter）提供了线索。
explain_zh: 天文学家利用詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜（JWST），在距离约65亿光年的Dragon星系中发现了104个被引力透镜效应（gravitational lensing）放大的恒星事件。研究团队通过分析2022至2024年间获取的图像，识别出这些恒星在穿过微焦散线（microcaustics）时亮度瞬间激增的现象。该研究不仅构建了目前单一星系中最大的高放大倍率恒星样本，还通过分析恒星颜色及事件分布，为理解恒星演化及“模糊暗物质”（fuzzy dark matter）模型提供了新线索。
snippet: Using the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), a team of astronomers identified 104 magnified stellar events in a galaxy known as the Dragon, located around 6.5 billion light-years away. This discovery more than doubles the previous record of 44 such detections in the same galaxy. Because these kinds of events reveal some of the most luminous stars and likely the presence of dark matter, this study offers a rare look at the galaxy's stellar population along with a possible hint at the nature of da

title: How space weather powers auroras in the sky and threatens power grids on the ground
title_zh: 空间天气如何引发极光并影响地面电网
summary_zh: 本文科普了空间天气如何通过太阳活动引发极光（aurora），并解释了这种现象背后潜在的电磁干扰，揭示了地球上层大气活动对现代地面电力系统的影响。
snippet: An aurora is one of nature's most spectacular light shows: It looks like green or red curtains rippling across the night sky. When viewed from the ground, this colorful display might seem far away and disconnected from anything happening on Earth's surface.

title: 100 buses long: Scientists map one of the world's largest known coral colonies
title_zh: 科学家测绘出世界已知最大的珊瑚群落之一
summary_zh: 研究人员在科科斯群岛（Cocos Islands）外礁发现了一处长达1.5公里的巨型珊瑚群落，这是目前记录到的最大珊瑚结构之一，对海洋生态研究具有重要意义。
snippet: A huge coral colony stretching more than 1.5 kilometers (0.93 miles) along the outer reef of the Cocos (Keeling) Islands has been identified by researchers, making it one of the largest known coral colonies ever recorded.

title: New species of ground-dwelling bird, the largest of its kind, identified in same cave as Homo floresiensis
title_zh: 弗洛勒斯岛发现史上最大型史前地栖鸟类化石
summary_zh: 考古学家在发掘“弗洛勒斯人（Homo floresiensis）”化石的Liang Bua洞穴中，鉴定出了一块被尘封已久的巨大鸟类腿骨，这是该地区已知最大的地栖鸟类遗骸。
snippet: In 2009, researchers working in the Liang Bua cave on Flores Island came across a leg bone. The 190,000–120,000-year-old fossil was identified as a bird bone and set aside. Like many bird bones before it, it was overlooked and left to collect dust.

title: Game theory helps SETI search for alien civilizations
title_zh: 博弈论或助力地外文明搜寻（SETI）
summary_zh: 研究人员指出，搜寻地外智慧生命时，不仅要考虑“在哪里看”，还要结合博弈论（game theory）推断“何时看”，以提高捕捉到地外文明信号的概率。
snippet: The search for extraterrestrial intelligence (SETI) is mostly concerned with where to look for technosignatures from another civilization. Between 2012 and 2015, SETI's Project Phoenix targeted about 1,000 sun-like stars for signs of intelligent life. But where to look might not be as important as when to look, according to scientists at SETI.

title: NASA Announces $1 Million to Students for Moon Base Challenge
title_zh: NASA启动百万美元月球基地设计竞赛
summary_zh: NASA面向美国在校学生发起“月球基地学生挑战赛”，旨在征集月球基地设计方案，以支持阿尔忒弥斯（Artemis）计划。
snippet: On Sunday, NASA announced the opening of its $1 million Moon Base Student Challenge during a MAX POWER event at Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex in Florida. As part of a Golden Age of Science, the competition invites student teams at U.S. high schools and post-secondary schools to contribute designs for the Moon Base. “We’re […]

title: 'Stupendously large' primordial black holes ruled out as a dark matter source
title_zh: 研究排除“超大”原始黑洞作为暗物质来源的可能性
summary_zh: 科学家通过观测分析排除了“超大”原始黑洞（primordial black holes）构成的暗物质理论，这类黑洞假设源于宇宙早期高密度物质的坍缩，而非恒星演化。
snippet: Primordial black holes are hypothetical objects that could have formed directly from dense clumps of matter in the very early universe. If they exist, their dramatic origins would set them apart from the black holes we see today, which form when massive stars collapse. Some theories suggest that "stupendously large" primordial black holes could account for a significant share of the universe's elusive dark matter.

title: Physicists listened to electrical noise to crack a superconductor mystery
title_zh: 物理学家通过分析电子噪声破解超导体谜题
summary_zh: 研究人员通过监测电子的电噪声（electronic noise）来判断电子是否形成了配对，这一发现有助于深入理解超导（superconductivity，即电阻消失的物理现象）机理。
explain_zh: 物理学家通过扫描隧道显微镜（scanning tunneling microscope）测量铜氧化物超导体（cuprates）中的电噪声（shot noise），揭示了其“赝能隙”（pseudogap）状态下的电子配对行为。实验观测发现，该材料在超导温度以上即已存在成对电子（Cooper pairs），其配对能量与赝能隙密切相关，这表明超导性的瓶颈在于如何让预先形成的电子对实现相位一致性（phase coherence）并同步运动。该研究有力反驳了赝能隙仅由电荷密度波等结构冻结导致的假设，为探索更高温度的超导体提供了新思路。
snippet: Tuning in to electronic noise can tell us whether electrons have paired up or not.

title: Want to fly to the moon? NASA is looking for new astronauts to help grow its Artemis program
title_zh: NASA开启新一轮宇航员选拔，助力月球探索
summary_zh: NASA正式向社会公开招募新一批宇航员，旨在扩充人才储备，推进阿尔忒弥斯（Artemis）计划及月球基地建设任务。
snippet: Want to fly to the moon and help build a permanent lunar base? NASA is accepting applications for a new astronaut class that will help grow the Artemis program.

title: Chimp sanctuary delivers an ape's food by drone amid Florida floods
title_zh: 佛州洪水期间无人机为黑猩猩运送食物
summary_zh: 受严重洪灾影响，佛罗里达州一家黑猩猩收容所使用无人机为受困动物运送食物，确保了动物的安全。
snippet: A Florida chimpanzee sanctuary had to deliver food to one of its 200 apes by drone this week because the property was swamped by heavy rain. But the animals stayed safe, and the water finally was receding significantly on Saturday, the organization said.

title: A nuclear blast could save Earth from an asteroid, but there's a catch
title_zh: 核爆拯救地球免受小行星撞击或存在局限性
summary_zh: 研究发现，利用核爆炸改变危险小行星轨道的效果极易受其不规则形状的影响，入射角度的微小偏差可能导致防御失败。
snippet: A nuclear explosion might save Earth from a deadly asteroid, but new research suggests that hitting the wrong side could make the difference between success and disaster. Scientists found that an asteroid's irregular shape can dramatically affect how it responds to an X-ray blast, with deflection effectiveness varying nearly fivefold depending on the angle.

title: Ancient Siberian tomb reveals surprising secrets of cannabis use 2,800 years ago
title_zh: 西伯利亚古墓发现2800年前大麻使用证据
summary_zh: 考古学家在西伯利亚一处古代斯基泰人（Scythian）墓穴中发现了大量大麻种子，提供了古人利用大麻致幻特性进行祭祀活动的直接考古证据。
snippet: Scientists investigating a 2,800-year-old Siberian tomb discovered roughly 1,000 cannabis seeds and chemical evidence suggesting ancient Scythians used the plant for its intoxicating effects. The remarkable find, surrounded by evidence of elaborate burial rituals and animal sacrifices, offers the oldest directly dated archaeological evidence of psychoactive cannabis use.

title: Scientists discover hidden brain changes linked to common sleep disorders
title_zh: 常见睡眠障碍可能导致大脑结构性改变
summary_zh: 一项综合分析57项影像学研究的发现显示，睡眠障碍与负责注意力和决策的大脑区域结构变化有关，这解释了睡眠不足为何影响认知功能。
explain_zh: 研究人员对57项脑成像研究进行了荟萃分析，发现多种睡眠障碍与大脑结构改变有关。研究显示，失眠、睡眠呼吸暂停等睡眠障碍患者的大脑丘脑（thalamus）区域体积缩小，影响了注意力与决策能力，而梦游、噩梦等异态睡眠患者则在大脑后扣带皮层（posterior cingulate cortex）表现出结构差异。这一成果揭示了睡眠问题与认知、情绪控制网络之间的生理关联，有助于未来开发更具针对性的诊断与治疗手段。
snippet: Scientists have discovered that sleep disorders are associated with structural changes in brain regions that control attention, decision-making, and emotions, potentially explaining why disrupted sleep can affect everyday thinking and behavior. The findings, drawn from 57 brain imaging studies, reveal both shared and disorder-specific patterns that could lead to more targeted treatments.

title: Scientists squeeze record-breaking X-ray power into an incredibly tiny spot
title_zh: 科学家实现超快X射线脉冲技术突破
summary_zh: 研究人员产生了持续时间仅300阿秒（attosecond，即10的负18次方秒）的极强X射线闪光，该技术有望用于观测电子的实时运动并精准控制化学反应。
explain_zh: 科研团队利用欧洲X射线自由电子激光装置（European XFEL），成功产生了持续时间仅300阿秒（attosecond）的超强X射线脉冲。研究人员通过先进的Kirkpatrick-Baez镜面系统，将脉冲聚焦至纳米量级，并在铜箔上观测到了放大自发辐射（amplified spontaneous emission, ASE）现象，验证了该脉冲极高的强度。此项突破为实时观测原子内电子的超快运动、甚至未来控制化学反应过程提供了强有力的工具。
snippet: Scientists have created record-breaking X-ray flashes lasting just 300 attoseconds, concentrating enormous power into an incredibly tiny spot. The breakthrough could unlock a new way to observe electrons in action and potentially control the ultrafast processes that drive chemical reactions.

title: Stronger flu shot linked to nearly 55% lower Alzheimer's risk
title_zh: 高剂量流感疫苗或能显著降低阿尔茨海默病风险
summary_zh: 一项针对近20万名65岁以上老人的观察性研究发现，接种高剂量流感疫苗的人群比接种标准剂量者，罹患阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease）的风险显著降低了约55%。
snippet: A surprising new study suggests that a stronger flu shot could offer older adults significantly greater protection against Alzheimer's disease. Researchers at UTHealth Houston analyzed nearly 200,000 adults ages 65 and older and found that those who received a high-dose influenza vaccine had a nearly 55% lower risk of developing Alzheimer's, compared with a 40% reduction previously associated with the standard-dose vaccine.

title: Mysterious gas leaks suggest Mars may still be volcanically alive
title_zh: 火星气体泄漏迹象暗示其地质活动尚未终止
summary_zh: 火星表面观测到的异常气体排放和新裂缝表明，火星深处可能仍存在岩浆活动，这增加了发现地下微生物生命存在的可能性。
snippet: Mysterious gas emissions and fresh volcanic fissures suggest that Mars may not be geologically dead after all, with hot magma potentially still active deep underground. The discovery could point to hidden pockets of warmth and chemical energy capable of supporting microbial life beneath the Red Planet’s surface.

title: A hidden limit of space and time could unlock electronics 100,000 times faster
title_zh: 量子时间空间极限或助力实现超高速电子器件
summary_zh: 科学家发现了一个限制电子时空精度的量子极限，通过利用该机制，未来有望研发出比现有技术快数十万倍的电子设备。
snippet: Scientists have discovered a surprising quantum limit that prevents electrons from being tracked with unlimited precision in both space and time. The breakthrough could pave the way for manipulating chemical reactions and developing electronics hundreds of thousands of times faster than today's technology.

title: APOD: 2026 November 8 – Major Fireball Meteor
title_zh: NASA发布火球流星影像
summary_zh: NASA每日天文图（APOD）展示了一颗壮观的火球流星（fireball），即亮度极高的流星现象，为公众科普了此类天体物理事件。
snippet: APOD Science APOD APOD: 2026 November 8 –… Today’s APOD Archive Submissions Index Search Calendar RSS Education About Discuss APOD Astronomy Picture of the Day Discover the cosmos! Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. Major Fireball Meteor […]

title: Why the tropics lose the most birds when cities expand
title_zh: 城市扩张对热带鸟类多样性的影响
summary_zh: 研究探讨了城市化对生态系统的影响，指出热带地区在城市扩张过程中比其他区域损失了更多的鸟类生物多样性。
snippet: Tropical ecosystems are famous for their teeming, exuberant diversity. In fact, the dramatic increase in biodiversity from the poles to the tropics—known as the latitudinal diversity gradient—is pervasive across branches of the tree of life, and fossil evidence suggests it has existed for millennia.

title: Personalized savings reminders can help boost retirement savings
title_zh: 个性化提醒如何促进退休储蓄
summary_zh: 这项社会科学研究探讨了心理学策略对经济行为的影响，比较了“获得性”与“损失性”提醒对个人参与退休储蓄意愿的不同效果。
snippet: Private retirement savings are an increasingly important topic in public debate. One popular idea is to phrase savings reminders in one of two ways: either you emphasize what someone stands to lose if they don't save, or you emphasize what they stand to gain if they do. To date, research into which of the two reminder messages is more effective in terms of influencing people's efforts to save has produced conflicting results.

title: NASA Awards Moon Base Transportation, Technology, Science Projects
title_zh: NASA推进月球基地建设相关项目
summary_zh: NASA宣布了一系列投资，旨在通过商业机器人送货、核动力月球车（nuclear-powered rover）PROMISE及基础设施建设，实现月球的长期驻留。
explain_zh: NASA发布了一系列月球基地建设规划，包括扩充月球商业载荷服务（CLPS）的承包商名单，并推进名为PROMISE的核动力月球车开发。研究者通过复用火星车技术构建PROMISE，利用核能解决月球长夜和永久阴影区的能源难题，计划于2028年底发射以勘探冰资源及地形。此举旨在通过商业化采购与迭代式开发，完善地月运输链路并为人类长期驻留月球奠定基础设施基础。
snippet: NASA announced a suite of awards and mission updates on Saturday to expand the agency’s Moon Base exploration, science, and infrastructure capabilities. The investments will advance commercial robotic deliveries, a nuclear-powered rover named PROMISE, launch and orbital transfer services, and surface infrastructure as the agency works with American industry to establish a sustained presence on […]

title: Student finds proof of rare wild cat in northern New Mexico
title_zh: 学生在美新墨西哥州发现稀有野生猫科动物踪迹
summary_zh: 一名学生在卡森国家森林（Carson National Forest）利用运动感应摄像机，意外拍摄到了稀有野生猫科动物的影像，为当地生物多样性研究提供了新线索。
snippet: Armed with dozens of motion-sensing cameras, William Grooms spent this past summer documenting wildlife across Carson National Forest in northern New Mexico. It was his first field season collecting photos for a two-year study to understand how forest structure influences biodiversity in the Southern Rocky Mountains.

title: The hidden ways insects support animal life—from habitat to health—go way beyond being food
title_zh: 昆虫在自然界中承担远超食物来源的关键角色
summary_zh: 昆虫不仅是动物的食物，还在维持生态系统服务（ecosystem services）中扮演关键角色，例如传粉和分解废弃物，对地球生态健康至关重要。
snippet: There are at least 14 million insect species on Earth, and they play highly diverse roles in sustaining the natural world. Insects provide many well-known benefits—what scientists often call "ecosystem services." For example, you can thank a bee or a hoverfly for pollinating wildflowers and agricultural crops, or credit dung beetles for decomposing manure and other waste materials.

title: Different text genres help doctoral students adapt their writing to reach new readers
title_zh: 不同文本体裁对博士生写作技能培养的启示
summary_zh: 研究指出，学术摘要、博客文章与科普文的写作要求迥异，博士生需针对不同读者群体和目的进行专门的写作训练，以提升跨领域交流能力。
snippet: An academic abstract, a blog post and a public outreach article all place different demands on the writer. Readers' prior knowledge varies, as does the purpose of the text and what needs explaining. Mastering one kind of text therefore does not automatically mean being able to write another.

title: NASA Seeks Next Generation of Explorers to Join Astronaut Corps
title_zh: NASA公开招募新一代宇航员
summary_zh: NASA正在招募新一批宇航员候选人，为执行未来的月球基地建设及首次载人火星探测任务做准备。
explain_zh: NASA正在开启新一轮宇航员招募，旨在选拔能够参与重返月球、建设月球基地及未来载人火星任务的候选人。申请者需具备美国公民身份，并拥有科学、技术、工程或数学（STEM）领域的硕士学位或同等资质，同时需满足相关专业工作经验或飞行时长要求。此次招募将持续至2026年12月3日，最终选定者将接受包括太空行走、月球地质等在内的专业训练，成为推动人类深空探测任务的关键力量。
snippet: NASA is looking for the explorers who will help write the next chapter of human spaceflight. Applications are now open for the agency’s next class of astronauts, who will join NASA as America returns to the Moon, builds the Moon Base, and lays the groundwork for the first crewed missions to Mars. The next generation […]

title: Two paths, one flux: Trapped ions simulate Aharonov–Bohm interference in a lattice gauge theory
title_zh: 捕获离子系统模拟阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆效应
summary_zh: 研究人员利用混合捕获离子（trapped-ion）量子计算机，在晶格规范理论（lattice gauge theory）的量子模拟中成功验证了阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆效应（Aharonov-Bohm effect），展示了量子模拟在理解基础物理现象中的应用。
snippet: In a new Nature Physics study, researchers demonstrated the Aharonov-Bohm effect in a quantum simulation of a lattice gauge theory using a hybrid trapped-ion quantum computer.

title: Earth's gravity may have kept the early moon's volcanic heart beating
title_zh: 地球引力或曾维持早期月球的火山活动
summary_zh: 针对嫦娥五号（Chang'e-5）带回样本的研究显示，月球火山活动比预期更晚。科学家提出，早期地球的引力潮汐作用可能为月球提供了额外热量，使其火山“心脏”得以多跳动了数十亿年。
explain_zh: 研究发现，约20亿年前月球表面仍存在火山活动，这可能是当时地月距离较近时，地球引力产生的潮汐加热（tidal heating）所致。研究团队通过计算机模拟，结合更真实的月幔（mantle）3D结构发现，月球核幔边界的特定区域能吸收巨大能量并维持高温。这一机制不仅解释了为何早期月球能产生玄武岩，还可能维持了月球早期的磁场，为理解月球地质演化提供了新视角。
snippet: We typically think of the moon as a static, floating object that has remained the same for basically its entire lifetime, with an occasional asteroid impact serving as an exception. That understanding is grounded in physics—the moon should have cooled rapidly after forming when a huge protoplanet hit the early Earth around 4.5 billion years ago. But some lunar material returned from the Chang'e-5 mission was notably formed only around 2 billion years ago, yet appeared to be volcanic in origin.

title: Scientists discover new jellyfish species in waters off Alicante in Spain
title_zh: 地中海发现微型水母新物种
summary_zh: 研究人员在西班牙阿利坎特沿海发现并描述了一种仅几毫米大的新水母物种Copula lucentia。这一发现再次证明，海洋中仍有大量未知的生物多样性等待探索。
snippet: The Mediterranean Sea still holds species unknown to science. One of them is Copula lucentia, a tiny jellyfish measuring just a few millimeters. Discovered off El Campello, in Alicante, it was formally described in 2024 by a research team at the University of Alicante (UA) Marine Laboratory in Dénia, which forms part of the university's Ramón Margalef Multidisciplinary Institute for Environmental Research.

title: Heavy rain can more than double glacier speeds in Alaska
title_zh: 大雨会导致阿拉斯加冰川滑动速度翻倍
summary_zh: 研究发现，强降雨会显著改变冰川的物理状态，使其滑动速度比平时快出数倍。这一现象挑战了传统认知中冰川是缓慢移动的“坚硬冰块”的观点。
snippet: Glaciers are often thought of as unyielding blocks of ice that slowly carve out the landscape as they move downhill by gravity. But sometimes their slow crawl becomes a surge that sees them move orders of magnitude faster than their usual speed.

title: The introduction of a medieval public health system exposed the population to roundworm
title_zh: 中世纪公共卫生干预曾导致寄生虫传播
summary_zh: 历史研究表明，中世纪特隆赫姆尝试改善公共卫生的手段适得其反，反而促进了蛔虫病（roundworm）的传播，揭示了公共卫生政策在实施过程中的复杂性。
snippet: Medieval health and sanitation efforts involved deliberate interventions; however, some of these measures had the opposite effect, leading to an increased spread of disease in Trondheim.

title: Theory predicting an older universe without dark matter or dark energy passes key cosmological tests
title_zh: 宇宙学新理论挑战暗物质与暗能量存在
summary_zh: 一项基于CCC+TL宇宙学模型的研究提出，宇宙年龄可能长达267亿年，且无需引入暗物质或暗能量即可解释宇宙观测数据，该结论通过了多项宇宙学检验。
explain_zh: 研究人员提出了一个名为“协变耦合常数加疲劳光”（CCC+TL）的宇宙学模型，该模型认为宇宙年龄约为267亿年，且无需暗物质或暗能量即可解释观测现象。通过对宇宙微波背景、轻元素丰度及星系旋转曲线等多个关键测试，该模型表现出与现有观测的高度一致性。该研究的局限在于其颠覆了标准宇宙学模型，仍需更多数据（如詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜的进一步观测）来验证其在解释早期超大质量星系方面的预测。
snippet: An alternative model in which the universe is 26.7 billion years old and needs neither dark matter nor dark energy has held up against several major cosmology tests, according to a new University of Ottawa study. The research, titled "A Big Bang Nucleosynthesis Consistency Test of the CCC+TL Cosmology," is published in the journal Universe.

title: Why treating soil acidity crop by crop is no longer enough for prairie farmers
title_zh: 加拿大草原农业需要跨周期土壤酸碱度管理
summary_zh: 研究建议加拿大西部农民应从单一作物视角转向多年度轮作视角来管理土壤酸度。这对于保障未来农业的可持续生产与粮食安全具有重要实践价值。
snippet: To protect their future harvests, Western Canadian farmers need to manage soil acidity across their entire multiyear rotation rather than crop by crop, long-term research from the University of Alberta suggests.

title: The Bantu expansion changed Africa. Scientists are still tracing how.
title_zh: 班图人扩张对非洲历史的深远影响
summary_zh: 科学家正利用基因学和考古学证据，进一步揭示班图语系民族（Bantu speakers）在非洲大陆的迁徙与扩张模式。这项研究有助于重构非洲文明演变的复杂历史。
explain_zh: 科学家通过跨学科合作，结合语言学比较、考古遗存分析及遗传学全基因组研究，勾勒出“班图人迁徙”（Bantu expansion）的复杂历史轨迹。研究确认班图人群体起源于西非，在数千年前向南及向东扩散过程中，将农耕、冶金和陶瓷技术带到了撒哈拉以南非洲。这一迁徙不仅改变了非洲的族群分布与基因结构，也促成了现代非洲大规模语言群体的形成，是人类历史上重要的一次人口迁徙事件。
snippet: Genes and archaeology are revealing how Bantu speakers spread across much of Africa.

title: Diwali celebrations coincide with worsening air. Here's how to stay safer
title_zh: 排灯节期间空气质量恶化与健康防护
summary_zh: 南亚地区（尤其是印度北部）在庆祝排灯节时常伴随着严重的冬季空气污染，研究强调了在此期间采取防护措施以降低呼吸系统健康风险的必要性。
snippet: For people across South Asia, especially in northern India, Diwali celebrations coincide with the return of hazardous winter air, raising concerns about how to celebrate safely.

title: Pakistani astronaut to board Shenzhou 24 and become the first foreigner on China's space station
title_zh: 巴基斯坦宇航员将入驻中国空间站
summary_zh: 据报道，一名巴基斯坦宇航员将参与神舟24号任务，这将使他成为首位进入中国空间站的外国籍宇航员，标志着航天领域国际合作的进一步深入。
snippet: A Pakistani astronaut will join the crew of China's Shenzhou 24 spacecraft on a mission that would make him the first foreign national to board Beijing's space station, state media reported Saturday.

title: Polar vortex faltering weeks earlier than ever recorded
title_zh: 极地涡旋出现史上最早异常减弱
summary_zh: 气象学家观测到极地涡旋（polar vortex）出现了前所未有的早期异常扰动。这一现象可能增加北半球出现寒潮天气的风险，但目前科学界对此仍存在高度不确定性。
snippet: Meteorologists said Friday they were observing an unprecedented early disruption of the polar vortex, raising the risk of cold snaps across the Northern Hemisphere, though there remains significant uncertainty.

title: Scientists discovered an unknown baby right whale off Canada. They say it's a cause for joy
title_zh: 加拿大海岸发现珍稀露脊鲸幼崽
summary_zh: 研究人员在加拿大海域发现了一头此前未知的露脊鲸（right whale）幼崽。这一发现为濒危鲸类的种群恢复带来了新的希望。
snippet: It would seem difficult to miss a 15,000-pound (6,804-kilogram) baby, but for months scientists who study rare whales did just that, and now they couldn't be happier.

title: Atlanta's new giant pandas will make their public debut after a 2-year absence
title_zh: 大熊猫回归亚特兰大动物园
summary_zh: 中断两年后，一对大熊猫即将重返美国亚特兰大动物园并与公众见面，这对于促进公众关注濒危物种保护具有积极意义。
snippet: Panda lovers are expected to line up Friday at Zoo Atlanta to see a new pair of giant pandas make their public debut.

title: Human bodies produce 2 billion metric tons of CO2 a year just by staying alive
title_zh: 人类呼吸产生的二氧化碳对气候模型的影响
summary_zh: 人类每年因生理活动呼出超过20亿吨二氧化碳，这是自然碳循环的一部分。科学家认为，提高对该数据的测量准确性有助于优化现有的气候模型。
snippet: Humans collectively produce more than 2 billion tonnes of carbon dioxide annually just by turning food into energy, a 74% increase over three decades largely driven by population growth. Unlike fossil fuel emissions, however, the CO2 we exhale is part of the natural carbon cycle, and scientists say measuring it more accurately could improve climate models.

title: Scientists discover Europe's ancient forests were nothing like we imagined
title_zh: 欧洲远古生态环境重构挑战现有植树策略
summary_zh: 研究发现欧洲在过去2000万年间以开阔林地和草地为主，而非原先认定的茂密森林。这一发现建议在生物多样性保护中，需谨慎对待人工种植大面积茂密森林的策略。
explain_zh: 研究通过对过去2300万年的古生态记录（包括化石花粉、沉积物DNA及食草动物牙齿化学特征）进行综合分析，发现欧洲历史上长期维持着由疏林、草地和湿地组成的半开放景观，而非此前认为的森林覆盖。该发现指出，大型食草动物的放牧活动是维持这种多样性生境的关键。这挑战了现代“密林造林”的生态保护策略，提示单一植树可能反而损害生物多样性。
snippet: Scientists have uncovered evidence that Europe was dominated for more than 20 million years by open woodlands, colorful meadows, and large grazing animals, not the dense forests long considered its natural state. The surprising discovery challenges modern reforestation strategies, suggesting that planting thick forests could actually harm the biodiversity conservationists hope to protect.

title: Rubin Observatory discovers two hidden companions of the Milky Way. Hundreds more may be waiting
title_zh: 鲁宾天文台发现银河系隐藏的卫星天体
summary_zh: 薇拉·鲁宾天文台（Vera C. Rubin Observatory）利用初步观测数据识别出了银河系未知的卫星天体。这预示着未来深空探测将揭示更多银河系的隐藏结构。
snippet: The Vera C. Rubin Observatory has already uncovered two previously unknown companions of the Milky Way using preliminary observations covering just 7% of the night sky. The discoveries include an extremely faint galaxy 355,000 light-years away and a star cluster hidden behind cosmic dust. Scientists suspect hundreds of additional satellite galaxies remain undiscovered, and Rubin's powerful telescope could finally bring them into view.

title: A dead star's mysterious rings reveal what could happen when our Sun dies
title_zh: 死星周围的双环结构预示太阳系未来
summary_zh: 天文学家在某死亡恒星周围发现了疑似由行星残骸构成的双环结构，其中的缝隙暗示了存在幸存的行星天体。这为了解恒星死亡后的行星系统演化提供了重要线索。
explain_zh: 天文学家利用甚大望远镜（VLT）发现了一颗白矮星（white dwarf）周围存在独特的双环碎片盘，环间空隙可能由幸存的行星体维持。该碎片盘富含钙、镁、氧、铁等元素，且内外环成分不同，暗示它们可能源自不同被毁行星的残骸。这一发现不仅展示了恒星演化末期的极端环境，也为未来太阳系在太阳死亡后的可能命运提供了观测参照。
snippet: Astronomers have discovered a strange double ring of planetary wreckage around a dead star, revealing a possible preview of our Solar System's distant future. The two rings are separated by a mysterious gap that researchers believe is maintained by surviving planetary bodies, including one potentially as large as Pluto or the Moon. Their different chemical compositions suggest they may contain the remains of separate destroyed planets.

title: Scientists accidentally solve a chemistry mystery that lasted 60 years
title_zh: 科研人员破解60年化学难题：稳定硼氧分子
summary_zh: 科学家成功合成了此前被认为极不稳定而难以捕捉的硼氧分子。这项实验突破可能会催生一系列新型奇异化合物，具有极高的基础科研价值。
snippet: After more than 60 years of unsuccessful attempts, scientists have finally isolated stable examples of elusive boron-oxygen molecules once considered too unstable to capture. The surprising breakthrough, achieved using relatively simple chemical reactions, could pave the way for an entirely new class of exotic compounds.

title: APOD: 2026 November 7 – De Gerlache-Kocher Massif
title_zh: 月球南极的地貌特征：De Gerlache-Kocher山块
summary_zh: NASA展示了月球南极地区De Gerlache-Kocher山块的精细影像。该区域因其特殊的光照条件和水冰潜力，是未来月球探测和基地建设的关键目标。
explain_zh: 天文学家通过望远镜捕捉到了月球南极附近De Gerlache-Kocher地块（Massif）的高清图像，该山脉高度约4公里。由于其山顶可获得几乎持续的太阳能，且阴影区可能蕴含水冰，该区域被视为月球首个载人定居点及Artemis计划潜在的着陆点。此次成像利用了月球的天平动（libration，即月球在轨道上的摆动效应），从而获得了这一独特的南极斜视视角。
snippet: APOD Science APOD APOD: 2026 November 7 –… Today’s APOD Archive Submissions Index Search Calendar RSS Education About Discuss APOD Astronomy Picture of the Day Discover the cosmos! Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. De Gerlache-Kocher Massif […]

title: Disasters and debt. Escaping the 'climate-debt doom loop'
title_zh: 气候灾害与债务：破解“气候-债务恶性循环”
summary_zh: 研究探讨了气候灾害对发展中国家造成的经济压力，特别是灾后重建引发的债务负担。这对于理解全球气候变化带来的社会经济影响具有重要参考意义。
snippet: It took around 480,000 trucks to haul away 4.8 million metric tons (5.3 million tons) of rubble across western Jamaica after Hurricane Melissa tore through the Caribbean in 2025, United Nations satellites showed.

title: Untangling the patterns of the cosmic microwave background to better understand the early universe
title_zh: 解构宇宙微波背景辐射，探索宇宙起源
summary_zh: 科学家通过观测宇宙微波背景辐射（Cosmic Microwave Background, CMB，大爆炸留下的残留热辐射），试图梳理其模式以揭示宇宙早期演化的奥秘。
snippet: A figure in red trudges across a blanket of white. Snow squeaks under the scientist's feet, too dry to be slick or soft. Only a line of flags and a few large buildings—the scientist's destination—break up the landscape. The sun hovers on the horizon, never quite setting against a blue sky devoid of clouds.

title: Spot a baby bird on the ground? Don't be tempted to bird‑nap it
title_zh: 路遇幼鸟请勿盲目救助
summary_zh: 春季是幼鸟学习飞行的季节，如果在地面发现幼鸟，通常不应将其带走，因为这可能会阻碍其正常学习生存技能。
snippet: Spring is the season of blooming flowers and buzzing bees.

title: The wasps that horrified Darwin reveal evolution's one-way streets
title_zh: 达尔文黄蜂：演化中的死亡专家
summary_zh: 研究寄生蜂达尔文黄蜂（Darwin wasps）的生活方式，揭示了自然界中极端演化策略的单一性，即通过寄生宿主并逐步吞噬存活的幼虫生存。
snippet: Few insects have a more gruesome lifestyle than Darwin wasps. Rather than simply hunting other animals, these parasitic wasps lay their eggs on or inside living hosts, including caterpillars, beetles and spiders. Their larvae then feed on their hosts, gradually consuming them and eventually killing them.

title: Air holes turn silicon wafers into flat ultraviolet focusing mirrors for compact optics
title_zh: 微孔结构让硅片化身为紫外超表面透镜
summary_zh: 通过在硅片上蚀刻空气孔，研究者开发出一种平面的紫外（ultraviolet）超表面（metasurface）反射镜。这种技术克服了传统材料吸收紫外光的难题，有望实现更紧凑的高分辨率光学成像系统。
snippet: Traditional lenses and mirrors focus light using curved surfaces. Metasurfaces can achieve similar functions with a flat layer of nanoscale structures that locally control the phase of light. Extending these flat optics into the ultraviolet could support compact systems for high-resolution imaging, spectroscopy, and sensing, but it introduces a fundamental materials problem: many of the materials used to make metasurfaces strongly absorb UV light.

title: How a metabolite protects the enzyme that consumes it
title_zh: 细胞通过反馈机制调节代谢酶
summary_zh: 研究人员揭示了色氨酸代谢中的分子调控机制：通过氨基酸与酶的特定位点结合，酶能实现“自我保护”以避免过度消耗。这一发现阐明了细胞维持代谢平衡的精细策略。
snippet: Metabolites are consumed by enzymes to produce other vital molecules as well as to control metabolite levels. But how do cells avoid consuming too much? Researchers from the MPI of Biochemistry, with the University of Nevada, Las Vegas, and the de Duve Institute in Brussels, have deciphered such molecular regulation in tryptophan metabolism. title: New method measures microplastics in the air using an uncrewed aerial system
title_zh: 无人机系统助力监测大气微塑料
summary_zh: 科研团队开发出一种利用无人机系统（uncrewed aerial system）在大气中采集并测量微塑料的方法，旨在深入研究这些污染物在大气中的移动规律。
snippet: Microplastics have been found in our bodies and the food we eat—and even in remote environments around the world, including seawater and ice in the Arctic. Despite their prevalence, little is known about how they move through the atmosphere. New CIRES-led research, which demonstrates a new method for sampling microplastics in the atmosphere using an uncrewed aerial system (UAS), aims to change that. The findings are published in the journal Scientific Reports.

title: Future warming events will outdo the extreme heat waves of the recent past, new study finds
title_zh: 未来气候变化将引发更严重的极端热浪
summary_zh: 发表在《自然-通讯》的研究表明，随着气候变化，未来的热浪将持续时间更长、影响范围更广且强度更大，过去的极端天气可能仅是未来的预演。
explain_zh: 研究指出，未来全球变暖将导致热浪在持续时间、影响范围及严重程度上显著超过近年纪录。研究者通过对比2010至2023年间的22起极端热浪事件与2020至2100年的气候模型预测，发现这种极端高温在21世纪末可能成为常态。即使采取减排措施，若无积极的适应手段，本世纪后期仍将面临远超近期体验的严酷高温挑战。
snippet: The extreme heat waves we have seen over the last few years may only serve as a preview of what is to come as a result of climate change. A new study led by researcher Philipp Aglas-Leitner from Freie Universität Berlin, published in Nature Communications, finds that future heat waves could last longer, impact larger areas, and be much more severe.

title: Light-powered method resurrects 'dead-end' compounds for drug discovery
title_zh: 光动力法让“死胡同”化合物重获新生
summary_zh: 研究人员开发了一种利用光能量的新方法，可将药物研发中原本被废弃的化合物“重新激活”，为发现新型药物提供了新的研究起点。
snippet: Throughout the drug development process, which can take a decade or more, tens of thousands of chemical compounds are produced that never go on to become medicines. A Florida State University researcher is part of a team that has discovered a new way to give some of these "dead ends" a second chance at becoming the foundation for tomorrow's blockbuster drugs.

title: Earth's churning mantle may have created the Great Unconformity
title_zh: 地球地幔对流或可解释“大不整合”
summary_zh: 科学家提出，地壳下方的地幔（mantle）运动可能导致了“大不整合”（Great Unconformity），即寒武纪沉积层直接覆盖在远古岩石之上的地质现象。这项研究有助于理解地表地质演变的历史。
explain_zh: 研究提出“大不整合面”（Great Unconformity，地球地质记录中长达数亿年的缺失）的形成，是地幔动力学与冰川侵蚀共同作用的结果。研究人员通过地幔对流模拟发现，地幔的热岩流导致大陆地壳发生长期的隆起与下沉，配合“雪球地球”（Snowball Earth）时期的强力冰川刨蚀，清除了地表岩层。该过程不仅解释了这一地质空白，还推测被冲入海洋的岩石碎屑可能为寒武纪生命大爆发提供了钙质养分。
snippet: Explaining the Great Unconformity, where Cambrian deposits sit on top of older rocks.

title: Quantum gas microscope reveals individual atoms in first tunable three-component Hubbard system
title_zh: 量子气体显微镜捕捉三组分哈伯德系统原子行为
summary_zh: 科学家首次在实验室中创建了可调控的三组分哈伯德（Hubbard）系统，并利用量子气体显微镜成功观测到单个原子。这为模拟核物理和材料科学中的量子行为提供了基础。
snippet: For the first time, an international team of researchers from Germany, Thailand, India, China and the United States has created a three-component Hubbard system with tunable interactions in the laboratory. In doing so, the team used a quantum gas microscope to make the individual atoms visible. The study, published in Science, provides an important foundation for future quantum simulations of nuclear physics and materials science.

title: European forests need to solve two crises—but not necessarily in one place
title_zh: 欧洲森林管理需在固碳与生物多样性间寻求平衡
summary_zh: 研究指出，森林既是重要的碳汇（carbon sink，指吸收并储存碳的场所）又是生物栖息地，但这两项功能并不总是能在同一片森林中实现最大化，欧洲林业政策需进行针对性规划。
snippet: Forest areas can act both as carbon sinks and as vital habitats for thousands of species—but not necessarily at the same time. This has important implications for how Europe should manage its forests, says a University of Copenhagen researcher.

title: MTG-I2 satellite delivers remarkable first images, capturing a weather view of Europe every 2.5 minutes
title_zh: MTG-I2卫星交付首批高频气象云图
summary_zh: MTG-I2气象卫星传回首批高分辨率图像，该卫星能每2.5分钟对欧洲进行一次全貌扫描，大幅提升了对突发极端天气的监测与预警能力。
explain_zh: 气象卫星MTG-I2成功传回首批高分辨率地球影像，展示了其每2.5分钟对欧洲及大西洋区域进行一次快速扫描的能力。该卫星通过地球静止轨道观测，能捕捉云层和天气系统的精细动态，不仅能帮助预报员监控快速演变的天气灾害，还能提供更精准的预警。这一功能对于应对暴雨、山火等快速发展的极端天气具有重要意义。
snippet: Europe's meteorological satellite agency, EUMETSAT, has released the first image from the Flexible Combined Imager (FCI) on board Meteosat Third Generation Imager 2 (MTG-I2), just over two months after the satellite's launch on Aug. 27, 2026. The satellite will provide forecasters with high-resolution observations of Europe every 2.5 minutes. This unprecedented frequency will help forecasters monitor fast-developing weather hazards more closely and support earlier, more precise warnings.

title: The John Lewis Christmas ad captures the deep need for grandmothers
title_zh: 从广告看祖母角色的社会价值
summary_zh: 本文讨论了某品牌年度圣诞广告将祖母作为主角的现象，分析了这一角色在家庭与社会中不可替代的情感支撑作用。
snippet: Like many of us, I always enjoy the John Lewis Christmas ad and 2026 is no different. This year, I love the fact that the star of the show is a grandmother.

title: Vibrating mirrors of light create analog of a black hole event horizon
title_zh: 利用光腔模拟黑洞事件视界
summary_zh: 科学家提出通过改变光腔中反射镜的距离，可能在光波中模拟黑洞事件视界（event horizon）附近的物理效应，为验证量子引力理论提供实验途径。
snippet: Optical cavities are pairs of light-trapping mirrors and underpin the operation of lasers, atomic clocks and many types of precision sensors. If the distance between the mirrors is changed rapidly enough, some theories predict that the waves inside them should bunch together into short, intense pulses. So far, however, this prediction has never been tested directly.

title: Atom-scale model could help improve material growth for advanced electronics
title_zh: 优化原子尺度模型以提升半导体材料生长
summary_zh: 研究人员通过精细化碳化硅（silicon carbide）晶体生长过程的原子尺度模型，旨在帮助制造业减少试错成本，提高先进制程电子材料的质量。
snippet: Penn State researchers have refined an atom-scale model of how silicon carbide changes from a solid into vapor during crystal growth, work that could help manufacturers produce higher-quality material for advanced electronics while reducing costly trial-and-error experiments.

title: States tax sports betting heavily, but gamblers may barely feel it
title_zh: 美国体育博彩税收现状分析
summary_zh: 探讨了美国博彩市场合法化以来的规模增长及税收政策，指出尽管政府征收重税，但由于税负转嫁机制，个人赌客对实际税负的感知并不明显。
snippet: Sports betting has grown explosively since 2018, when a U.S. Supreme Court ruling struck down a federal ban on it. Now, Americans wager more than $165 billion on sports annually, contributing to an industry larger than state-run lotteries even excluding prediction markets such as Kalshi and Polymarket.

title: Evolutionary history and genetic basis of spruce diversification revealed
title_zh: 揭示云杉属植物的演化与多样化史
summary_zh: 研究通过解决长期存在的基因信号冲突问题，理清了广泛分布于北半球的云杉属（Picea）植物的系统发育关系和进化历程。
snippet: The genus Picea (spruce) is widely distributed across the Northern Hemisphere and is a dominant component of boreal and montane forests. Understanding the evolutionary processes that have shaped diversification and regional differentiation across the genus requires a well-resolved phylogeny of Picea. However, the evolutionary history of Picea has long been obscure due to conflicting genetic signals.

title: Scientists achieve record-breaking low temperature on China's space station, paving the way for new physics experiments
title_zh: 中国空间站创下极低温记录
summary_zh: 中国空间站近期实现了创纪录的超低温环境，这一成果将为在微重力下研究量子物理及探索物质新状态提供关键实验平台。
snippet: Matter starts to behave differently at extremely low temperatures, creating conditions ideal for studying quantum physics and new states of matter. Now, researchers from China have achieved a new low-temperature record aboard their Tiangong space station. Their research, recently published in Science, might lead to a new generation of experiments in quantum physics and precision measurements in space.

title: Technique that spots tRNAs in action could accelerate drug development for inherited diseases
title_zh: 新型tRNA动态监测技术助力遗传病药物研发
summary_zh: 研究人员开发了一种监测转移核糖核酸（tRNA）运作的新技术，有助于深入理解蛋白质合成过程，并为针对遗传疾病的药物研发提供靶点。
snippet: Human cells turn genetic instructions into proteins with great precision. Critical for the translation of this information are transfer RNAs, or tRNAs, small molecules that read the genetic code three letters at a time and bring the matching building blocks of proteins, the amino acids, to the cell's protein-making machinery, the ribosome.

title: Researchers establish G0 founder population carrying targeted mutations in marine mollusks
title_zh: 海洋软体动物基因编辑育种获突破
summary_zh: 研究团队成功培育出经过基因编辑的海洋软体动物后代，克服了幼体变态发育的难关，为水产育种技术的改良奠定了基础。
snippet: Although genome-editing-based breeding has advanced rapidly in aquaculture, progress in marine mollusks has lagged behind. The main challenge is not genome editing itself, but rather rearing the few edited larvae through metamorphosis to establish a viable G0 founder population.

title: M30’s Sparkling Stars
title_zh: 哈勃望远镜拍摄球状星团M30
summary_zh: NASA发布了哈勃望远镜拍摄的球状星团M30影像。该星团是天文学家查尔斯·梅西耶早期编制天体目录时的观测目标，展现了银河系演化的历史遗迹。
snippet: This NASA/ESA Hubble Space Telescope image released Nov. 5, 2026, provides a lesson in galactic history. The sparkling collection of stars is named Messier 30 (M30) after the French astronomer, Charles Messier, who cataloged M30 and other diffuse objects that might be mistaken for comets in the early telescopes of Messier’s time. M30 lies about […]

title: Robot successfully builds space structure in first autonomous construction demo
title_zh: 机器人首次自主完成太空结构建造
summary_zh: 加州理工学院研发的机器人桁架建造系统成功在太空中自主组装结构，标志着无人空间基础设施制造技术迈出重要一步。
snippet: A robotic truss builder that was conceived, designed and built by Caltech researchers has successfully built a structure in space—without the help of astronauts—for the first time. The truss builder, part of DARPA's Novel Orbital and Moon Manufacturing, Materials, and Mass-efficient Design (NOM4D) program, consists of an autonomous manipulator that picks up struts and joints held in nearby dispensers to repeatedly assemble identical sections, or bays, of a perimeter truss.

title: New method for upcycling polyethylene is suitable for mass production as a raw material for nylon
title_zh: 塑料废弃物高效转化为尼龙原材料
summary_zh: 德国化学家提出了一种将聚乙烯（polyethylene）塑料转化为二元羧酸的方法，为利用废旧塑料规模化合成尼龙（尼龙，polyamide）提供了可持续的工业路径。
snippet: It would greatly benefit the environment and climate if nylon—chemically known as polyamide—could be produced on a large scale from plastic waste in the future, rather than from petroleum, as has been the norm until now. At LIKAT in Rostock, chemists pursuing this approach have succeeded in selectively converting polyethylene—the main component of all plastic waste—into dicarboxylic acids, which can serve as chemical precursors for nylon.

title: Supercomputing Tech Demo Schedule
title_zh: NASA展示超级计算领域前沿技术
summary_zh: NASA在超级计算会议上展示了包括Fortran语言新模板等在内的技术进展，旨在推动科学计算的高效与可靠性。
snippet: Supercomputing 2026 Join NASA in the Exhibit Hall (Booth #4038) for presentations by NASA experts. Full Tech Demo schedule below.
